title: Yunikorn k8shim: HTTP/2 servers could end up crashing due to inadvertently modifying its HPACK encoder concurrently…
description: A concurrency issue in the yunikorn-k8shim package's HTTP/2 server implementation can cause crashes by inadvertently modifying the HPACK encoder concurrently. This vulnerability affects versions prior to 1.9.0-r1 and has been fixed in version 1.9.0-r1.
